item.subject: science
item.stem:
Multiple choice question: Meena finds four things in her school garden in Jaipur. She wants to know which one is living. She should check whether it shows all the life characteristics such as needing food, growing, respiring, responding to stimuli, and reproducing. Which of the following statements is correct ( )
A. A plastic ball lying in the garden is living because it can roll when pushed.
B. A neem sapling is living because it needs water and air, grows, respires, and can reproduce.
C. A dry, fallen leaf on the ground is living because it was once part of a tree.
D. A moving toy car is living because it shows movement like an animal.

options.A: A plastic ball lying in the garden is living because it can roll when pushed
options.B: A neem sapling is living because it needs water and air, grows, respires, and can reproduce
options.C: A dry, fallen leaf on the ground is living because it was once part of a tree
options.D: A moving toy car is living because it shows movement like an animal
